address_comment_regular: [Verified] ActorProcessManager_RegisterTempEffect increments the effect reference and routes GetTypeID 4-6 into extendedTempEffects (+0x48), all other IDs into activeTempEffects (+0x40). Vtable evidence confirms decals 0/1 and particles 2 use the active list. Fallout divergence: its BGSDecalManager updates distinct simple-decal and emitter collections instead of using this per-actor temp-effect routing; one-to-one equivalence is Unknown.
